description: The spine stacks a column of vertebrae that balance the torso, transmit weight, and let artists show elastic gesture from skull to sacrum.

landmarks.name: Atlas and axis
landmarks.desc: First cervical pair that cradle the skull and signal nodding pivots.

landmarks.name: Cervical transverse processes
landmarks.desc: Winglike lateral bars that frame the neck's contour in oblique light.

landmarks.name: Ligamentum nuchae
landmarks.desc: Midline fibrous curtain spanning the cervical spines and supporting trapezius origins.

landmarks.name: Spinous processes C7–T12
landmarks.desc: Posterior spines that step down the thoracic back and catch sharp highlights.

landmarks.name: Lumbar transverse processes
landmarks.desc: Sturdy lateral shelves that anchor deep muscles and broaden the waist.

landmarks.name: Sacral ala
landmarks.desc: Flaring wings of the sacrum that merge into the pelvis and seat the torso.

landmarks.name: Dorsal sacrum
landmarks.desc: Rough midline surface of the sacrum where gluteus maximus fibers root.

landmarks.name: Coccyx apex
landmarks.desc: Tailbone tip that anchors the most inferior gluteus maximus fibers.
